title: Now defaults to in-progress work
description:
Now is a look at work that is happening. By default it shows only in-progress issues.

Operators can choose other statuses with `--status` (CLI) or the Now status filter (console). `--status all` shows every status. Named issue IDs still show those issues even when they are not in progress.

## Gherkin

```gherkin
Feature: Now status filter
  Scenario: Now lists only in-progress issues by default
    Given an in-progress issue and an open issue
    When I run "kanbus now --list"
    Then stdout contains only the in-progress issue

  Scenario: Now --status all lists every status
    When I run "kanbus now --list --status all"
    Then stdout contains both issues

  Scenario: Now panel defaults to in-progress issues
    When I switch to the "Now" view
    Then only in-progress issues are listed
```

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Now defaults to in-progress on both CLI and console.

CLI: `kbs now` lists only in_progress. `--status all` shows every status. Comma-separated values work. Named issue IDs skip the default filter.

Console: Status select on the Now panel defaults to In Progress. Chattic.us Now shows the two in-progress items by default; All reveals the rest of the tree.
